clips.title: The story
paras: Near Auberdine's watch, Ranger Glynda Nal'Shea directs the defense of Darkshore. The seasoned night elf sentry sends travelers to meet threats and investigate strange signs along the coast.

From Auberdine, Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea coordinates scouts as corruption grows and hostile forces press into Darkshore. She watches the wilderness around town and relies on capable travelers to guard the perimeter and protect night elf holdings along the coast.

Glynda watches for dangers gathering along the shore, especially the bolder murlocs south of town. She oversees bounties on threats such as Murkdeep and sends scouts to examine strange finds, including a crimson crystal reported near Darkshore's eastern mountain range.
